name: The Orb's Adventures Beyond the Ultraworld

podcast.body: This album, alongside The KLF's *Chill Out*, significantly influenced the development of the genre. It played a crucial role in establishing the sound and direction of early electronic ambient music, setting a precedent for subsequent artists in the emerging scene. "el primer trabajo de Dior, Diorp's Adventure, Billion de Ultra World, marcaron el devenir del género."
